summary: Migrated from GNOME to KDE Plasma and applied coordinated dark macOS-inspired styling
changes: Installed 30 repository packages including SDDM, Kvantum and KDE application replacements. Removed 21 explicitly reviewed GNOME desktop and application packages without recursive orphan removal. Retained credential store, shared libraries, browser, ChatGPT, games and graphics drivers. Applied reviewed upstream WhiteSur Dark assets as an ordinary user: Plasma style, Aurorae decoration, Kvantum styling, purple icons and cursors; refined existing top bar and floating autohide dock; retained static wallpaper. Enabled SDDM for next boot with stock greeter; current session left running. Updated maintenance desktop preference. Standard package setup created the SDDM service account; authentication policy not edited.
tests: Package file-presence checks passed; no failed system units; only Plasma login session remains; SDDM enabled. Native color, desktop-theme and cursor tools succeeded; Kvantum theme accepted; KWin reconfigure succeeded; runtime panel query confirmed settings. Initial cursor search-path issue resolved using a user icon-directory link. One mirror download failed and fallback succeeded. Next-boot SDDM login and representative gaming performance remain untested; existing applications may require reopening.
rollback: Private configuration backups and exact package manifests retained. Restore affected user files after logout. Reinstall reviewed removed desktop packages from repositories or signed cache after version review; enable former login manager for a later deliberate restart. Keep credential data intact; no automatic dependency cleanup.
problem: Basic initial customization did not meet requested macOS appearance. No reproducible CachyOS distribution defect established.
solution: Applied coordinated dark macOS-like desktop, window decoration, application style, icon and cursor assets rather than changing only palette and panel positions.
reproduction: Visual acceptance requires inspecting the running Plasma session; login-manager transition requires a deliberate future restart. No game benchmark was executed.
